info.name: PizzaHub - Vendor Menu API tests
info.description: See docs/VENDOR_MENU_TESTING.md. Run the folders top to bottom, in a fresh Postman session. Use a demo database, not your real one.

item.name: 1. No login (run FIRST, with an empty cookie jar)
T2 GET without login -> 401
T2 POST without login -> 401
T2 PATCH without login -> 401
T2 DELETE without login -> 401
2. Setup (sign up / sign in the test users, save JWTs)
Vendor A: sign up (ok if the user already exists)

exec: pm.test("signed up, or the user already exists", () => pm.expect([200, 400, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Vendor A: sign in
Vendor A: get JWT

exec: pm.test("token received", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("vendorAToken", t); });

request.description: Uses the session cookie stored by the sign-in request right above it.

item.name: 3. Role checks
T1 Customer GET -> 403
T1 Customer POST -> 403
T1 Customer PATCH -> 403
T1 Customer DELETE -> 403
T1 Admin GET -> 403 (admin is not a vendor)
4. Vendor reads and creates
T3 Vendor A lists own items (new vendor: empty)

exec: pm.test("data is an array + pagination", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(b.pagination).to.have.property("totalItems"); });

item.name: T4+T5 Vendor A creates an item -> 201, status pending
T3 Vendor A sees the new item in own list (pending)
T3 Vendor B does NOT see Vendor A's item
T17 Pending item is NOT on the public menu -> 404
T16 Create with vendorId in the body -> 400
T16 Create with status:approved in the body -> 400
T16 Create with subscriptionPlan in the body -> 400
T16 Create with price -5 -> 400
T16 Create with an invalid image URL -> 400
T16 Create with missing fields -> 400
5. Update
T6 Vendor A updates own item -> 200 (still pending)
T6 PATCH with status:approved -> 400 (protected)
T6 PATCH with vendorId -> 400 (protected)
T16 PATCH with an empty body {} -> 400
T7 Vendor B updates Vendor A's item -> 404
T15 PATCH with an invalid id -> 400
PATCH a valid but unknown id -> 404
6. Availability (vendors cannot approve)
T11 Vendor tries to activate a PENDING item (self-approval) -> 409
T11 Vendor tries to deactivate a PENDING item -> 409
Availability with status in the body -> 400
T7 Vendor B changes Vendor A's availability -> 404
T15 Availability with an invalid id -> 400
7. MANUAL STEP: needs the item to be approved first (see docs)
item.description: There is no admin API yet. In Compass/mongosh set the status of the item whose id is in {{itemId}} to "approved", then run this folder. Run in order.

item.name: (check) the item is public now -> 200
T10 Vendor deactivates own approved item -> 200 inactive
T17 Inactive item is NOT on the public menu -> 404
T10 Vendor re-activates it -> 200 approved
(check) public again -> 200
T6 Editing an APPROVED item sends it back to pending
T17 ...so it is hidden from the public menu again -> 404
8. Delete
(setup) Vendor A creates an item to delete
T9 Vendor B deletes Vendor A's item -> 404
T15 DELETE with an invalid id -> 400
T8 Vendor A deletes own item -> 200
Deleting it again -> 404
9. Free plan limit (3 active = pending + approved)
T12 Free vendor item 1 of 3 -> 201
T12 Free vendor item 2 of 3 -> 201
T12 Free vendor item 3 of 3 -> 201
T12 Free vendor 4th item -> 403 FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED
10. Premium and expired Premium (needs one-time DB setup, see docs)
item.description: premium.vendor@pizzahub.test must have subscriptionPlan premium + a future subscriptionExpiresAt; expired.vendor@pizzahub.test premium + a PAST date. Both are set once in Compass/mongosh (snippet in the docs). Re-running is safe.

item.name: T13 Premium vendor item 1 -> 201 (no limit)
T13 Premium vendor item 2 -> 201 (no limit)
T13 Premium vendor item 3 -> 201 (no limit)
T13 Premium vendor item 4 -> 201 (no limit)
T13 Premium vendor item 5 -> 201 (no limit)
T14 Expired Premium item 1 -> 201, or 403 if already at 3 (re-run)

exec: pm.test("201, or 403 FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED on a re-run", () => { if (pm.response.code === 403) { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql("FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED"); } else { pm.response.to.have.status(201); } });
